hq.label: Classroom
hq.prompt: A UK primary school classroom: group tables with chairs, a blank whiteboard, coat pegs, a display board with blank coloured paper, plants on the windowsill, big windows with daylight.

hq.label: Playground
hq.prompt: A UK school playground: a climbing frame, painted hopscotch shapes without numbers, benches, a low fence and trees, a sunny day.

hq.label: Library
hq.prompt: A school library corner: low bookshelves with colourful blank book spines, beanbags, a rug and a reading lamp.

hq.label: Quiet room
hq.prompt: A calm sensory room: soft mats, beanbags, a small tent, fairy lights, soft blue and purple light.

hq.label: Lunch hall
hq.prompt: An empty, tidy school lunch hall: long tables, stacked trays, a serving counter; calm and quiet.

hq.label: Home
hq.prompt: A cosy room at home: a sofa with blankets, a rug, a shelf with toys and plants, warm lamp light.

hq.label: Space
hq.prompt: Outer space: a small rocky moon surface as the floor, planets and stars in the sky, a distant spaceship.

hq.label: Under the sea
hq.prompt: Under the sea: a sandy floor, coral, seaweed, bubbles, light rays from above.

hq.label: Jungle
hq.prompt: A jungle clearing: mossy ground, giant leaves, hanging vines, a waterfall far behind.

hq.label: City rooftop
hq.prompt: A city rooftop at night: a flat roof as the floor, a water tower, a skyline with lit windows, the moon.

hq.label: Sky castle
hq.prompt: A castle on a floating island above the clouds: a stone courtyard floor, towers with plain pennants, clouds below.

hq.label: Secret lab
hq.prompt: A secret spy base: a round vault door, consoles with glowing buttons, radar screens and a wall map made of abstract shapes, all without writing.

situations.label: Too loud
situations.prompt: A school lunch hall full of bean figures, with big jagged sound-wave shapes bursting from every side and clattering trays.

situations.label: Nobody gets what I mean
situations.prompt: Two bean figures looking puzzled at an empty space in the centre; floating speech bubbles filled with scribbles and question marks.

situations.label: Waiting
situations.prompt: A long school corridor with a queue of bean figures, a big wall clock and an hourglass; a gap in the queue in the centre foreground.

situations.label: I did it!
situations.prompt: A gold trophy, stars and confetti bursting around an empty spotlight circle in the centre; bean figures clapping at the sides.

situations.label: Asked to answer
situations.prompt: A classroom seen from the side: bean figures at desks all turning to look at an empty chair in the centre, lit by a spotlight; a blank whiteboard behind.

situations.label: Someone is unkind
situations.prompt: A playground corner: two bean figures at the edge with spiky dark speech bubbles pointing at an empty space in the centre; a small grey cloud above that space.

situations.label: Plans change
situations.prompt: A visual timetable of blank picture cards on a wall; one card flipping over and swapping with a big question-mark card; swirling arrows.

situations.label: Somewhere new
situations.prompt: An open doorway glowing with light into an unfamiliar room with unknown shapes; footprints leading from the empty centre foreground to the door.

situations.label: Playtime
situations.prompt: A sunny playground: bean figures playing tag and ball at the edges, a ball mid-bounce, open space in the centre.

situations.label: Tricky work
situations.prompt: A school desk at the bottom of the picture with a worksheet of tangled scribble lines (no letters), a broken pencil, crumpled paper balls, and a small storm cloud of squiggles above.

The Time door! Powers to stop, slow and save time.
The Sound and light door! Powers for noise and brightness.
The Words door! Powers that help everyone understand.
The Turns door! Powers for whose turn it is.
The Screens door! Powers over the school's machines.
The Together door! Powers to share with friends.
Slow everybody down! The whole school moves like a tortoise now.
Pause my school! Freeze! Nobody moves. Not even the teachers.
Hold my turn! Your agent's turn is saved, like a ticket. Nobody can take it.
Warn me first! A little bell rings before anything changes.
Say it again! Rewind! The words come back, nice and slow.
Turn the classroom down! Shhh… All the noise fades away.
Dim the classroom lights! Click. Soft, calm light everywhere.
Quiet bubble! Your agent floats inside. The noise just bounces off.
Translator! Pictures turn into words. Words turn into pictures.
Everyone talks my way! Now everyone talks your agent's way.
Get-what-I-mean ray! Zap! Now everyone understands your agent.
Control teachers! Press a button, and the teacher does it.
Question swap! This time, the teacher answers the question.
Pass! Your agent can skip this one. No problem.
Invisibility cloak! Whoosh. Nobody can see your agent now.
Control all school displays! Every screen shows what your agent wants.
Control school devices! The bell, the lights… your agent is in charge.
See my points! Your agent sees the points. Nothing is hidden.
Change a school rule! Out with the old rule. In with a new one.
Speak for your friends! Your agent says it for them.
Call an ally! A friend runs over to help.
Team up! Two agents together are even stronger.
Talking! Saying it out loud, with words.
Signing! Talking with hands, like Makaton.
A secret handshake! A rhythm only your agent knows.
Drawing! Showing it with a picture.
Acting it out! Showing it with the whole body.
Picture cards! Pointing at a picture to say it.
Writing! Putting the words on paper.
A device! A tablet that talks for your agent.
Talk a lot! Lots of talking, all day long.
Only talk! Words out loud, and nothing else.
Learn Makaton! Signs that go with words.
Look at who's talking! Eyes on the speaker.
Answer quickly! Say the answer straight away.
Speak up! Loud and clear, so everyone hears.
Write it down! Put it on paper.
Use picture cards! Point at pictures to say things.
Use a device! A tablet that helps with talking.
Too loud! When school gets noisy, the power kicks in.
Nobody gets what your agent means? Then the power kicks in.
Waiting, and waiting… That's when your agent uses it.
I did it! When your agent wins, the power appears.
Asked to answer, with everyone looking. That's the moment.
Someone is unkind. Your agent's power is ready.
Plans change! Something new, all of a sudden. Your agent is ready.
Somewhere new! A new room, new faces. The power helps.
Playtime! Out in the playground, the power is on.
Tricky work! When it gets hard, the power helps.
Me! The power works on your agent.
A friend! The power works on a friend.
My teacher! The power works on the grown-ups at school.
My class! The whole class feels the power.
Everyone! The whole school feels the power.
The room! The lights, the sounds, the whole room changes.
My badge! Tap the badge, and on it goes.
My secret handshake! Tap the rhythm, and the power wakes up.
A hand sign! One secret sign, and the power switches on.
A secret word! Say it, and the power switches on.
A drawing! Draw the sign, and the power begins.
A button! Press it, and the power switches on.
The school bell! Your agent decides when it rings.
The fire alarm! Your agent controls how it sounds.
The lights! Brighter, softer, on or off. Your agent decides.
The speakers! Louder or quieter. Your agent decides.
The whiteboard! Your agent chooses what it shows.
The computers! Your agent is at the controls.
A power to give! Your agent gives one of its powers away.
My handshake! Your agent's secret rhythm goes inside.
A drawing! Draw something to put inside.
Something your agent can't live without! Draw it or say it.
Your agent's safe place! It goes inside the bottle.
My secret word! It goes inside, in its spy voice.
For me! It stays safe on your shelf.
For a friend! It goes in the post for your friend.
For my teacher! It goes in the post for your teacher.
For everyone! It goes up on the big screen.
